game.name: Diablo III - Reaper of Souls - Ultimate Evil Edition
game.desc: Diablo III: Ultimate Evil Edition includes the expansion pack Reaper of Souls and features special four-player co-op features. With the wireless controller and a custom-designed console interface, players will be outfitted with touch pad functionality and new social features as they engage in pulse-pounding combat with hordes of monsters and acquire items of incredible power.
game.genre: Role-playing (RPG), Strategy, Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure
